release_policy: Authorised to go live ONLY AFTER all independent CEFR/English/Myanmar/example review, real George and Emma listening, automated desktop/mobile and physical iPhone Safari, hosting and privacy QC are documented and passed. This file is a template, not evidence of approval.
notes: Record actual evidence separately from the 1000 provisional first-pass drafts and their review tasks.
Never manufacture reviewer identities, source observations or physical-device listening checks.
Any changed approved definition, Myanmar meaning, example, level or part of speech invalidates its previous content-hash receipt.
An audit of fields and URLs is mechanical evidence-integrity checking, not independent linguistic judgement.
Never publish without all gates and real human-supplied attestations.
Oxford source-list mismatches and absent-core-list headwords require actual reviewer resolution for each retained flagged entry, never automatic retiering.
Shared headwords with the protected IELTS 1000 bank require an actual documented semantic/pedagogical review; some overlap is legitimate.
Audio listening receipts must match the cryptographic digest of each actual George/Emma recording; mismatched or missing recordings count as unverified.
